stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Moose Knucklers has been laid to rest (15.79 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 30.1 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: TDsMaGee has yet to start RJ Harvey. Starting him in Weeks 1, 3, 4 and 6 would have meant 3 more wins by now (+27.50 pts).
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: In My Fantasy Era leads the chopping-block odds at 31%, with Mel's Mediocre Mob next at 27%.
🎸 DEEP CUTS: Ramosverse is starting Hutchinson (3%), Douglas (14%) and McLaughlin (19%) while Washington (95%) and Nix (64%) sit. % = rostered across ESPN.
🤝 Rivalry week: Claremont In Yo Stace! leads TDsMaGee 6–2 all-time, and Claremont In Yo Stace! has won the last 3.
🥊 Heavyweight bout: #1 Brock You Like a Hurricane (5–1) meets #4 Mr. Action Jackson (4–2).
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads Ruffing the Passer 5–1 all-time, and Gibb it to Me Baby has won the last 2.
🚑 INJURY WARD: Mr. Action Jackson is absolutely slammed — Jackson (Rd 3), Warren (Rd 5), Moore (Rd 6) and Evans (Rd 7) are out.
🎲 Kirbo Crushers is rolling with 2 kickers and just 2 healthy RBs. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 6 straight. Can they snap it against 49er Faith-Fool?
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
